blocks.text: Buying a Single-Family Detached House in Pitt Meadows, BC

parts.t: Detached houses in the City of Pitt Meadows are prized for flat, walkable streets, family cul-de-sacs, and scarce inventory. According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® September 2026 MLS® HPI, the benchmark price for a single-family detached house in Pitt Meadows is $1,178,600. Median detached lot sizes in Q3 2026 were 5,439 sq ft in Central Meadows, 6,006 sq ft in Mid Meadows, and 7,204 sq ft in South Meadows.

Buyers comparing urban detached homes choose between established 1970s–1990s ranchers, split-levels, and two-storey family homes on 6,000–7,500+ sq ft R-1 lots around Highland Park Elementary, Davie Jones Elementary, and Pitt Meadows Elementary, or newer post-2006 Craftsman two-storey homes near the Fraser River dike trail and Waterfront Commons Park in Osprey Village.

blocks.text: Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, Secondary Suites, Floodplain FCLs & ALR Rules

parts.t: Because over 85% of Pitt Meadows lies within the Fraser, Pitt, and Alouette river floodplains behind 60 km of dikes, detached home buyers should understand Flood Construction Levels (FCLs—why slab-on-grade, crawlspace, and basement-entry designs dominate rather than deep inground basements), secondary and garden suite rules under City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011, and Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) house-size caps in North, West, and South Meadows.

parts.t: What is the benchmark price for a detached house in Pitt Meadows?
According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® September 2026 MLS® Home Price Index report, the benchmark price for a single-family detached house in Pitt Meadows is $1,178,600.

Why do many Pitt Meadows houses have crawlspaces instead of deep basements?

Because more than 85% of Pitt Meadows lies within the diked floodplain (Kennedy Area 3 in the urban core), municipal Flood Construction Levels (FCLs) historically favoured rancher, split-level, crawlspace, or above-grade basement-entry designs rather than deep below-grade basements.
Are secondary suites and garden suites allowed in Pitt Meadows houses?

Yes, City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 permits secondary suites and detached garden suites on qualifying urban residential lots subject to lot area, off-street parking, floodplain elevation, and building permit requirements.
Which SD42 schools serve detached homes in Pitt Meadows?

Elementary catchments are Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Rd, English and Early French Immersion K-7), Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Rd), Highland Park Elementary (18961 Advent Rd), and Edith McDermott Elementary (12175 Bonson Rd), all feeding into Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Ave).
What rules apply to houses on ALR farmland in North Meadows?

Detached houses in the Agricultural Land Reserve (78% of Pitt Meadows land) are governed by provincial ALC floor-area limits and City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 farm home plate setbacks, and rely on private septic systems.
